name: Owl
overview: The Bible identifies owls as unclean creatures, frequently mentioned alongside other birds of prey and desolate places, as seen in Leviticus 11:16-17 and Deuteronomy 14:15-16. These verses emphasize their classification within the dietary laws, underscoring their separation from clean animals. Additionally, some translations, including Job 30:29 and Isaiah 13:21, substitute or associate owls with ostriches, linking them to wilderness and desolation imagery that reflects judgment and desolation. This portrayal highlights the owl's symbolic connection to desolation and impurity within the biblical narrative.
